historySource.indexText: Established as a parkway under National Park Service by act of May 18, 1938. The Ackia Battleground (authorized as a national monument Aug. 27, 1935) and the Meriwether Lewis Park (proclaimed a monument Feb. 6, 1925 and transferred from War Dept.
